item.title: The Appalling Stupidity of Spotify's AI DJ
item.description:
📝 Unfortunately, this tradition is not much respected in the sphere of digitized music. When I explored this issue back in 2009 in my blog entry Classical Music and MP3 Players, I discovered that the metadata associated with digital music files is based entirely on pop music. If nothing in the metadata indicates that these movements are part of a longer composition, Spotify remains ignorant of that fact.
🔗 Read more: https://www.charlespetzold.com/blog/2026/02/The-Appalling-Stupidity-of-Spotifys-AI-DJ.html
